verdict.comment: Having been beaten just a head on her recent reappearance at Redcar, WITHOUT FLAW is taken to go one better. Stroxx is feared.

comments.azucena: 0-10 on grass but well treated on AW form and case can be made on last month's Thirsk 6th
comments.canariaqueen: Well handicapped on last year's best efforts but the forecast fast ground is a concern
comments.dunningtonlad: Two wins off higher marks at Ripon last summer; however, hasn't shone so far this season
comments.goldenprosperity: Won over C&D last August but he's failed to threaten on his three outings this year
comments.hyrcanian: Beaten a long way on her five starts in the last 12 months and she'd be a surprise winner
comments.ifonlytheycudtalk: Last month's C&D sixth can possibly be upgraded and he might not be far away
comments.irishdancer: Maiden who was well beaten on reappearance but has each-way shout on last year's best form
comments.jamiebond: Disappointing at Musselburgh last time but this C&D winner could bounce back now back here
comments.jamieschoice: Went close over C&D on reappearance but two lesser runs have followed
comments.latinfive: Better could have been expected at Redcar recently but he's of interest on his course form
comments.mrsbagerran: Returns from a break on a handy mark and she has some good C&D form; a possible
comments.poshmaisie: No better than fifth across her six starts this year and well beaten last time; now 0-15
comments.stroxx: Disappointing 11 days ago but in good form previously, including for C&D win
comments.withoutflaw: Poor strike-rate but went close on recent reappearance; major player if backing that up
comments.woohoo: Ex-Irish maiden; 5th of 6 on recent stable debut; could take step in right direction today

races.raceComment: canariaqueen is marginally preferred with a score of 51.8%, holding clear edges in better ratings over jamieschoice. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This is all about SPRING CHORUS (nap), who bolted up on her stable debut at Beverley and should be tough to beat under a 5lb penalty.

comments.fanaigilinn: Has dropped down the weights but she struggled to get competitive last year; now 0-18
comments.irv: 6lb lower than when winning last June but tailed off on reappearance three weeks ago
comments.ladyphoebe: Short-headed at Hamilton last August but that's a rare high point; 0-13 on the Flat
comments.madeall: 0-16 and untested at this trip but it's worth a go judged on his latest effort over 1m2f
comments.maxofstars: Below par this year but on a competitive mark and has had wind op since last time
comments.pacospride: Placed last May/June but not so good at the end of her campaign; 22-race maiden
comments.penelopessister: Lightly raced 1m3f winner who returned from absence with fair third at Ayr recently
comments.princehector: AW classified win in March but below par in AW handicaps the next twice
comments.queenroslyn: Very lightly raced 4yo; returns from absence and has shown very little thus far
comments.sassyglory: 15-race maiden but placed a few times last season and fair C&D run on reappearance
comments.springchorus: Easy win on recent stable debut and could take plenty of stopping under a 5lb penalty
comments.stardelta: 0-6 and yet to threaten but in good hands and has hinted this step up in trip may suit
comments.tiberioforce: Made the frame in 2 classified races last August but well beaten in 3 handicaps since

races.raceComment: springchorus is confidently preferred with a score of 51.6%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over maxofstars. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.allwaysglamorous: Should be capable of further success judged on pedigree; interesting handicap debutant
comments.fouradaay: Modest strike-rate over the last two years but is on an attractive mark
comments.ginormous: Ex-Irish 4yo; ran creditably on debut for new yard and may show progress; shortlisted
comments.honouryourdreams: Placed off this mark in three starts since wearing a hood; solid contender
comments.miggymagic: Maiden who has shown signs that he's capable of winning a race of this nature; shortlisted
comments.notremaison: Sole C&D winner in this field; possibilities, provided she copes with this higher grade
comments.secrethandsheikh: Last four wins at Brighton; however, posted best effort this year over C&D
comments.somenightmare: Close third over C&D two weeks ago; remains 2lb below last winning mark

comments.sixofdiamonds: Makes belated debut aged five with a 7lb claimer booked; best watched
comments.thesweetescape: Showed ability at Wolverhampton eight weeks ago; open to improvement
comments.topwarrior: Commonwealth Cup entry who should build on Kempton success and progress further; respected

comments.aramisgrey: On a long losing sequence but is a consistent sort; has won over C&D; fighting chance
comments.baldomero: Lacks recent match practice; gained turf wins on soft/heavy; others preferred
comments.buccabay: Below par in two runs for new stable; now returns from a layoff; check the betting
comments.coupdeforce: Hasn't won on turf since 2022 but ran well (close third) in this contest last year
comments.havanagreattime: Registered a 20-1 win at Newbury last time, taking record to 4-14; has scored over C&D
comments.ladydreamer: AW success when last seen 100 days ago; made the frame in this race 12 months ago

comments.regalenvoy: Productive sort; won at Newmarket most recently, taking strike-rate to 10-34; respected
comments.treacherous: In-form veteran but this is harder than his C&D assignment last Monday
comments.trefor: Has form figures of 115 over C&D; 2-2 in Class 3 events; interesting back in this grade

races.raceComment: regalenvoy is marginally preferred with a score of 60.3%, holding clear edges in superior course form over havanagreattime. Won 3 of last 6 starts. comments.laserfocus: String of poor runs on the Flat since two wins over hurdles last November; hard to fancy
comments.lunadipinta: Well beaten at a big price on her return from a layoff recently; goes back up in trip
comments.myna: Pulled away his chances for his new yard recently and can do better if more amenable
comments.pockettoo: This more realistic and market confidence on his handicap debut should be noted
comments.seriouslook: Attracted support ahead of his C&D comeback; fair chance he defies a 5lb rise
comments.spiritofbowland: Hammered with a 10lb rise; this strong traveller now has to prove his stamina up from 1m
comments.strategicfortune: Four-time C&D winner; said to have been unsuited by racing wide latest; can do better
comments.trustyscout: Returned from more than a year off in good form and the step back up to further will suit
comments.valkyrja: Longer trip is far from assured on pedigree; want to see support before considering her

races.raceComment: cityescape is marginally preferred with a score of 52.6%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and more reliable profile over trustyscout. verdict.comment: Easy to pick holes in most of these and HAVE YOU A MINUTE gets the nod. Pessoa has often pulled hard when going this far before.

comments.aikhal: Bit more here latest and this easier again but two previous efforts in blinkers were poor
comments.desertraider: Pleasing comeback at 40-1 but that was a muddling affair and he has to prove his stamina
comments.edenstorm: Regressive and doesn't look the easiest these days; also has stamina to prove
comments.haveyouaminute: Win and a near-miss to his name in three starts over C&D; one to consider
comments.monkmoorpip: Entitled to need this first run in more than a year; want to see some market interest
comments.pessoa: Five-time course winner (four over the extended 7f); little wiggle room off this mark
comments.snoozelane: C&D victory last April came off a 6lb higher mark; bolder showing wouldn't surprise
comments.starofjupiter: Run poorly in handicaps since a shock C&D win; profile is not the most convincing
comments.tasmanianlegend: Dual course winner who's on a dangerous mark; hung left when below market billing latest
comments.threeyorkshiremen: Handicapper giving him every chance but he's regressed since wind surgery

races.raceComment: snoozelane is marginally preferred with a score of 51.3%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over tasmanianlegend. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The lightly raced WILLOW'S KISS, who's taken time to settle down, will find this easier on her Tapeta debut. Dumfries is next best.

comments.alshabab: Southwell second reads well enough but it came four months ago and he's drawn wide tonight
comments.balmybreese: Had endless chances and recent efforts haven't been good; only holds outside claims
comments.bizarrelaw: Regressive for Andrew Balding last year and has continued the slide for his current yard
comments.bluejayway: Inclined to pull hard in two runs back here this spring; isn't without hope if he settles
comments.cheesetheone: Only seen once in the last 16 months, when well beaten over 6f here last November
comments.dumfries: Race fell kindly latest, back on turf without the blinkers but he's capable off 3lb higher
comments.juancooldude: Finished well held in two runs back this spring and is hard to make a case for
comments.mudlahhim: Plenty of chances at this sort of level last year; last two runs here haven't been great
comments.outreach: Couldn't get to the front from stall 12 here latest and history may well repeat itself
comments.roguethunder: Back in form ten days ago and won't mind going back up to 7f, so will be popular again
comments.vitalline: Handicapper's giving him a chance; won't mind the step back up from 6f from a better draw
comments.willowskiss: Said to have got unbalanced at Lingfield latest; low mileage compared to the rest of these

races.raceComment: roguethunder is marginally preferred with a score of 57.5%. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The quirky HAAF A DIAMOND is worth risking off a career-low mark. Star Of Atlantis is another for the very short shortlist.

comments.almizan: Huge prices for three starts this spring, including on her handicap debut last Monday
comments.americanstar: Regressive and has never been quite this far during a long career; not obviously fancied
comments.beautifuldawn: Claims in weak handicap on her C&D third in February but that's rather clutching at straws
comments.bravedisplay: Years appear to be catching up; pulled hard when a long way behind Star Of Atlantis latest
comments.bravemusketeer: Latecomer to the game who's started three-figure prices all runs, generally finishing last
comments.cammy: Poor maiden who missed a huge chunk of his career; has struggled for five different yards
comments.capallcliste: Capable off this mark if settling better; therein lies the gamble back from six weeks off
comments.changeoffortune: Drawn wide on his C&D comeback from six months off a fortnight ago but didn't offer much
comments.haafadiamond: Can pull hard and hasn't done much in three runs on Tapeta, but is quite capable
comments.hellavapace: Likes Brighton but not at her best in two runs there this spring; needs to bounce back
comments.hinitsabay: Needs to settle much better from the outside stall now handicapping; watch the market
comments.starofatlantis: More consistent since cheekpieces went on and is one to consider off her last winning mark

races.raceComment: hellavapace is marginally preferred with a score of 45.4%, holding clear edges in better ratings over bravedisplay. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
